description: This file implements two classes related to Text-to-Speech (TTS) services within a larger project: InworldHttpTTSService (HTTP-based) and InworldTTSService (WebSocket-based). It provides mechanisms for initializing TTS services, managing WebSocket and HTTP connections, processing streaming and non-streaming responses, and extracting word-level timing information for synthesized speech. The file integrates with external modules like aiohttp, websockets, loguru, and pydantic, and references several project-specific modules for frames, processing, and utils. This code specifically manages interactions with Inworld AI's TTS API, supporting advanced features like context management, interruptions, and timestamping, making it a core component for interfacing with the Inworld TTS system.

classes.name: InworldHttpTTSService
classes.description: HTTP-based TTS service supporting streaming and non-streaming modes; manages HTTP communication with Inworld API and processes responses including word timestamps and audio content.

classes.name: InworldTTSService
classes.description: WebSocket-based real-time TTS service utilizing bidirectional communication; manages WebSocket connections, contexts, message handling, interruptions, and audio streaming with support for word-level timestamps.
